1. **Randomized controlled trial of atorvastatin in mild to moderate Alzheimer disease: LEADe.**
   Authors: H H Feldman, R S Doody, M Kivipelto, D L Sparks, D D Waters, R W Jones, E Schwam, R Schindler, J Hey-Hadavi, D A DeMicco, A Breazna, LEADe Investigators
   Journal: Neurology
   Publication Date: 2010-04-06
   PMID: 20200346
   Abstract: There is some evidence that statins may have a protective and symptomatic benefit in Alzheimer disease (AD). The LEADe study is a randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating the efficacy and safety of atorvastatin in patients with mild to moderate AD.
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20200346/
